real-estate.outlook: Bristol leading South West regeneration with Temple Quarter and Western Harbour. Plymouth and Exeter growing city centres. Bath and Bournemouth attracting institutional investment. Housing delivery pressure across region.

utilities.outlook: South West Water and Wessex Water AMP8 programmes. National Grid upgrading for Hinkley Point C grid connection. Western Power Distribution major investment. Severn Trent covering parts of region.

defence.outlook: HMNB Devonport largest naval base in Western Europe. Babcock major submarine refit programme. RNAS Yeovilton investment. MOD Boscombe Down testing capability.

infrastructure.outlook: Hinkley Point C transformational for Somerset. South West flood and coastal defence investment significant. NHS hospital programmes. School rebuilding active.

rail.outlook: A303 Stonehenge tunnel progressing. Network Rail CP7 Great Western programme. MetroWest Bristol suburban rail. South West mainline resilience at Dawlish.
